name: AFR 113 发动机失效 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 113, you're holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 AFR 113，你在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，已完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 113, holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 113，在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, hold at present position.

C: AFR 113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
B: Tell the controller yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边航空器了吗？
B：告诉管制员看到了。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact departure 120.2
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 113，许可起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2。

cards.audioText: B: You are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 113, passing 900 meters, request cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 113，正通过 900 米，请求取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, radar identified, continue climb to 2,400 meters, turn right to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 113，雷达识别，继续爬升至 2,400 米，右转直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right, LKO, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 2400 米，右转，LKO，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: AFR 113, climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 113，爬升至 4500 米，并联系武汉管制 119.7。

cards.audioText: B: Your position is just over LKO, the next waypoint is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的位置刚好在 LKO 上空，下一个航路点是 DAPRO，预计到达时间 34，做标准位置报告并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 113, over LKO, ETA DAPRO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 113，飞越 LKO，预计 DAPRO 34，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，爬升至5100米，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction, AFR 113.

cards.audioText: B: During the climb, your port engine fails, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中左发失效，请向管制员报告情况并申请返航着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR 113, our port engine fails, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR 113，我们左发失效，申请返航着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Roger PAN, AFR 113, descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到紧急信号，AFR 113，下降至1800米，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360, AFR 113.

cards.audioText: B: Your altitude is 1800 meters, you have information S, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前高度1800米，已收到通播S，请联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, 1800 meters, information S.

cards.audioText:
AFR 113, current information is T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS Runway 36L.
B: Read back and ask to use Runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
cards.audioTextZh:
AFR 113，当前情报为 T，下降至 900 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36L。
B：复诵，并因性能限制请求使用 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: information T, descend to 900 meters; request Runway 36R due performance, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 情报 T，下降至 900 米；因性能限制请求 Runway 36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, Change landing Runway 36R.
B: You have just got the information from the cabin that one of your passengers suffered stroke during the incident. Inform the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 113，更改落地跑道为 Runway 36R。
B：你刚刚从客舱获悉，一名乘客在此次事件中突发中风。通知管制员，并请求落地后安排救护车。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, one of our passengers suffered stroke, request ambulance after landing, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，我们的一名乘客突发中风，请求落地后安排救护车，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: roger AFR 113, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，AFR 113，我们将通知机场医疗救助。现在左转航向 330，下降至 600 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，左转航向 330，下降至 600 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for RWY 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：报告你已截获 Runway 36R 的航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, established on the localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，已建立在 Runway 36R 航向道上。
